title.zh: 由 60 MHz 台式 NMR 推出 C_{13}H_{18}O_{2} 的结构
title.en: Solving C_{13}H_{18}O_{2} from 60 MHz benchtop NMR

prompt.zh: 在 CDCl_{3} 中用 60 MHz 台式仪器测得 ^{1}H、^{13}C、COSY、HSQC-ME 和 HMBC。推出结构并归属每一个峰。
prompt.en: ^{1}H, ^{13}C, COSY, HSQC-ME and HMBC measured in CDCl_{3} on a 60 MHz benchtop instrument. Deduce the structure and assign every peak.

note.zh: 位移、J 值、积分和正文写明的相关峰都取自下面所列的实测数据。带 ≈ 或 * 的是来源没有逐个写出的值。
note.en: Shifts, J values, integrals and the correlations stated in the text are measured data from the source below. Items marked ≈ or * are not spelled out by the source.

answer.zh: 答案：2-[4-(2-甲基丙基)苯基]丙酸（布洛芬）

sources.label: Oxford Instruments application note: Structural Elucidation by Benchtop NMR Spectroscopy, Ibuprofen (X-Pulse; 1H 60 MHz, 13C 15 MHz, 40 °C, 1 mol/L in CDCl3)

covers.zh: 实测：7 组 ^{1}H 信号的位移、裂分、J 和积分（11.94 s 1H；7.46–6.83 m 4H；3.69 q 7.1 Hz 1H；2.44 d 6.7 Hz 2H；1.89 多重峰 6.7 和 6.3 Hz 1H；1.48 d 7.2 Hz 3H；0.88 d 6.3 Hz 6H）；9 个 ^{13}C 位移及各自的碳数（181.36、140.93、137.19、129.51 ×2、127.43 ×2、45.21 ×2、30.25、22.51 ×2、18.21）。COSY：4-CH_{3} 与 3-CH 相关，9-CH_{2}、10-CH、11-CH_{3} 三者之间相关（包括四键的 9/11）。HSQC-ME：δ_{C} 45.2 同时与 3.69 和 2.44 的 H 相关；CH、CH_{3} 为正相位，CH_{2} 为负相位。HMBC：3.69 的 H 与 127.4（芳 CH）和 137.2（芳季碳）相关。原子编号沿用该文。其余相关峰只出现在该文的图中，本页按结构预期画出并用 * 标明。
covers.en: Measured: shift, multiplicity, J and integral of the seven ^{1}H signals (11.94 s 1H; 7.46–6.83 m 4H; 3.69 q 7.1 Hz 1H; 2.44 d 6.7 Hz 2H; 1.89 multiplet 6.7 and 6.3 Hz 1H; 1.48 d 7.2 Hz 3H; 0.88 d 6.3 Hz 6H); nine ^{13}C shifts with their carbon counts (181.36, 140.93, 137.19, 129.51 ×2, 127.43 ×2, 45.21 ×2, 30.25, 22.51 ×2, 18.21). COSY: 4-CH_{3} with 3-CH, and among 9-CH_{2}, 10-CH and 11-CH_{3} (including the four-bond 9/11 pair). HSQC-ME: δ_{C} 45.2 correlates with both the 3.69 and the 2.44 protons; CH and CH_{3} have positive phase, CH_{2} negative. HMBC: the 3.69 proton correlates with 127.4 (aromatic CH) and 137.2 (aromatic quaternary C). Atom numbering follows the note. Other correlations appear only in its figures; here they are drawn as expected from the structure and marked *.

rule.zh: 一个苯环占 4 个（3 个 C=C 加 1 个环）。
rule.en: A benzene ring accounts for 4 (three C=C plus one ring).

so.zh: 假设：一个苯环，再加一个双键或环。两个 O 提示可能是 C=O。
so.en: Hypothesis: one benzene ring plus one more double bond or ring. Two oxygens hint at a C=O.

title.zh: 清点氢谱：7 组峰，18 个 H

text.en: Seven signal groups with integrals 1 : 4 : 1 : 2 : 1 : 3 : 6, which sum to exactly 18H.

rule.zh: 这是 60 MHz 的谱：1 ppm 只有 60 Hz，所以 7 Hz 的裂分在图上看起来比高场仪器上宽得多。
rule.en: This is a 60 MHz spectrum: 1 ppm is only 60 Hz, so a 7 Hz splitting looks much wider on the ppm axis than at high field.

so.zh: 所有 H 都有着落，没有多余的峰。高场一侧有四组清楚的裂分，是好入口。
so.en: Every H is accounted for and nothing is left over. The four clean multiplets at high field are a good way in.

title.en: δ 11.94: the proton at lowest field

ask.zh: 1H 单峰出现在 δ 11.94。什么样的 H 会跑到这么低场？
ask.en: A 1H singlet at δ 11.94. What kind of proton appears this far downfield?

rule.zh: 羧酸的 O–H 在 10–13 ppm；醛基 H 在 9.5–10，够不到这里。
rule.en: A carboxylic acid O–H appears at 10–13 ppm. An aldehyde H sits at 9.5–10 and does not reach this far.

so.zh: 片段：–COOH。它用掉两个 O，C=O 正好是第 5 个不饱和度。
so.en: Fragment: –COOH. It uses both oxygens, and its C=O is the fifth degree of unsaturation.

check.zh: 还要碳谱里有一个 175–185 ppm 的羰基来配合。
check.en: A carbonyl at 175–185 ppm in the carbon spectrum must back this up.

rule.zh: 6H 出现在同一个位移，是两个等价的 CH_{3}。双峰说明它们都只挨着 1 个 H。
rule.en: Six H at one shift means two equivalent CH_{3} groups. A doublet means each has exactly one H neighbour.

ask.zh: 异丙基的 CH 已经有 6 个甲基 H 做邻居。这个 1H 的多重峰线数很多，另一侧还有几个 H？
ask.en: The isopropyl CH already has six methyl H as neighbours. This 1H multiplet has many lines. How many more H are on its other side?

text.zh: δ 1.89，1H，多重峰，含两个偶合常数：6.3 Hz 和 6.7 Hz。
text.en: δ 1.89, 1H, a multiplet containing two couplings: 6.3 Hz and 6.7 Hz.

rule.zh: 偶合常数成对出现：6.3 Hz 和 0.88 的甲基双峰相同，6.7 Hz 属于另一组邻居。两个 J 接近时，n 个邻居给出大约 n + 1 条线。
rule.en: Couplings come in pairs: 6.3 Hz matches the methyl doublet at 0.88, and 6.7 Hz belongs to another set of neighbours. With similar J values, n neighbours give about n + 1 lines.

so.zh: 这个 CH 一侧是 6 个甲基 H，另一侧还有邻居，其 J 为 6.7 Hz。去找谁也带着 6.7 Hz。
so.en: This CH has six methyl H on one side and further neighbours with J = 6.7 Hz on the other. Next, find the signal that also carries 6.7 Hz.

check.zh: 来源把这个峰记作 qt。按结构它是七重峰再裂成三重峰（6 + 2 个邻居），因为两个 J 接近，看起来像九重峰。外侧的线很弱，容易数少。
check.en: The source labels this signal qt. From the structure it is a septet of triplets (6 + 2 neighbours), which looks like a nonet because the two J values are close. The outer lines are weak and easily missed.

rule.zh: 6.7 Hz 正是 1.89 那个 CH 的另一个偶合常数。CH_{2} 只裂成双峰，说明它另一侧连的原子上没有 H。烷基 CH_{2} 在 2.3–2.7 ppm，通常连着芳环或羰基。
rule.en: 6.7 Hz is exactly the other coupling of the CH at 1.89. A CH_{2} that is only a doublet has no H on the atom at its other side. An alkyl CH_{2} at 2.3–2.7 ppm normally sits on an aromatic ring or a carbonyl.

so.zh: 片段：(CH_{3})_{2}CH–CH_{2}–，异丁基，另一端连着一个不带 H 的 sp^{2} 碳。
so.en: Fragment: (CH_{3})_{2}CH–CH_{2}–, an isobutyl group whose far end sits on an sp^{2} carbon without H.

check.zh: 是芳环还是羰基，现在还定不了。
check.en: Ring or carbonyl cannot be decided yet.

title.zh: 第二个自旋体系：四重峰配双峰
title.en: A second spin system: quartet plus doublet

text.en: δ 3.69, quartet, J = 7.1 Hz, 1H. δ 1.48, doublet, J = 7.2 Hz, 3H.

rule.zh: 四重峰 = 3 个邻居，双峰 = 1 个邻居，J 又相同：这是 CH–CH_{3}。普通烷基 CH 在 1.5 ppm 左右，移到 3.7 说明它同时连着两个吸电子基团。
rule.en: A quartet means 3 neighbours and a doublet 1 neighbour, with the same J: this is CH–CH_{3}. An ordinary alkyl CH is near 1.5 ppm, so 3.7 means it carries two electron-withdrawing groups.

so.zh: 片段：CH_{3}–CH<。这个 CH 除了甲基之外，另外两根键连的原子都不带 H。
so.en: Fragment: CH_{3}–CH<. Apart from the methyl, the other two bonds of this CH go to atoms without H.

check.zh: 7.1 和 7.2 Hz 是同一个偶合，差 0.1 Hz 在读数误差之内。
check.en: 7.1 and 7.2 Hz are the same coupling. A 0.1 Hz difference is within reading error.

title.zh: 芳香区：60 MHz 下读不出花样
title.en: Aromatic region: no readable pattern at 60 MHz

rule.zh: 苯环上 4 个 H 就是二取代苯。当两组 H 的位移差（以 Hz 计）和 J 差不多大时，谱是二级的，不能按 n + 1 规则读。60 MHz 下 0.2 ppm 只有 12 Hz，和邻位 J（约 8 Hz）同一量级。
rule.en: Four ring H means a disubstituted benzene. When the shift difference in Hz is comparable to J, the spectrum is second order and the n + 1 rule fails. At 60 MHz, 0.2 ppm is only 12 Hz, the same order as an ortho J of about 8 Hz.

so.zh: 片段：–C_{6}H_{4}–。邻、间、对哪一种，氢谱定不了，交给碳谱。
so.en: Fragment: –C_{6}H_{4}–. Ortho, meta or para cannot be decided from the proton spectrum. The carbon spectrum will do it.

check.zh: 图上把这团峰画在范围的中点 7.15 附近，峰形只是示意。
check.en: The lump is drawn near 7.15, the midpoint of the reported range. Its shape is schematic only.

title.zh: 碳谱：13 个碳只有 9 个峰

ask.zh: 芳香区只有 4 个碳信号，其中 129.5 和 127.4 各是 2 个碳。邻、间、对二取代苯分别应该有几个芳碳信号？
ask.en: The aromatic region has only 4 carbon signals, and 129.5 and 127.4 are 2 carbons each. How many aromatic carbon signals would ortho, meta and para disubstituted benzenes give?

text.zh: 除去 CDCl_{3} 的三重峰，共 9 个信号。181.4 是羧基；140.9 和 137.2 是不带 H 的芳碳；129.5 和 127.4 是芳 CH，各 2 个碳。
text.en: Apart from the CDCl_{3} triplet there are 9 signals. 181.4 is the carboxyl carbon; 140.9 and 137.2 are aromatic carbons without H; 129.5 and 127.4 are aromatic CH, 2 carbons each.

rule.zh: 两个取代基不同时：邻位和间位二取代苯有 6 个芳碳信号，对位有一条对称轴，只有 4 个（2 个季碳，2 个各含 2 碳的 CH）。
rule.en: With two different substituents, ortho and meta disubstituted benzenes show 6 aromatic carbon signals. Para has a symmetry axis and shows only 4: two quaternary carbons and two CH signals of 2 carbons each.

so.zh: 苯环是对位二取代。181.4 也印证了 –COOH。
so.en: The ring is para-disubstituted. The 181.4 signal also confirms –COOH.

check.zh: 来源没有给出 CDCl_{3} 三重峰的位移，图上按通常的 77.0 画，并标了 ≈。
check.en: The source gives no shift for the CDCl_{3} triplet. It is drawn at the usual 77.0 and marked ≈.

title.en: HSQC-ME: δ 45.2 is really two carbons

ask.zh: 脂肪区只有 4 个碳信号（45.2、30.3、22.5、18.2），但我们已经找到 5 种带 H 的脂肪碳。少的那个去哪了？
ask.en: The aliphatic region shows only 4 carbon signals (45.2, 30.3, 22.5, 18.2), yet we have found 5 kinds of protonated aliphatic carbon. Where is the missing one?

text.zh: δ_{C} 45.2 这一行有两个交叉峰：一个对着 3.69 的 H，一个对着 2.44 的 H。两个峰的相位相反。
text.en: The row at δ_{C} 45.2 has two cross peaks: one to the proton at 3.69 and one to the protons at 2.44. The two peaks have opposite phase.

rule.zh: HSQC 只显示直接相连的 H–C。多重度编辑的 HSQC-ME 里，CH 和 CH_{3} 是正相位，CH_{2} 是负相位。
rule.en: HSQC shows only directly bonded H–C pairs. In multiplicity-edited HSQC-ME, CH and CH_{3} have positive phase and CH_{2} negative.

so.en: C-3 (a CH) and C-9 (a CH_{2}) happen to share the shift 45.2. Carbon count: 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 13, complete.

check.zh: 这是偶然重叠。一维碳谱上只看到一个稍高的峰，没有 2D 很容易漏掉一个碳。带 * 的灰色虚线圈是按归属预期的相关峰，来源只在图里给出。
check.en: This is accidental overlap. The 1D carbon spectrum shows just one slightly taller peak, and without 2D a carbon is easily lost. The grey dashed rings marked * are correlations expected from the assignment, given by the source only in a figure.

title.zh: COSY：两个互不相通的自旋体系
title.en: COSY: two spin systems that do not talk to each other

text.zh: H-3 只与 H-4 相关。H-9、H-10、H-11 三者之间互相相关，其中 H-9/H-11 是隔四根键的弱峰。两组之间没有任何交叉峰。
text.en: H-3 correlates only with H-4. H-9, H-10 and H-11 correlate among themselves, the H-9/H-11 peak being a weak four-bond one. No cross peak links the two groups.

rule.zh: COSY 沿着 H–H 偶合走，读法是 对角线 → 交叉峰 → 对角线。偶合链遇到不带 H 的原子就断。
rule.en: COSY follows H–H coupling and is read diagonal → cross peak → diagonal. A coupling chain stops at any atom without H.

so.zh: 体系 A：CH_{3}–CH（4–3）。体系 B：CH_{2}–CH–(CH_{3})_{2}（9–10–11）。两者之间隔着不带 H 的原子，与一维谱的裂分完全一致。
so.en: System A: CH_{3}–CH (4–3). System B: CH_{2}–CH–(CH_{3})_{2} (9–10–11). Atoms without H separate them, in full agreement with the 1D splittings.

title.zh: 拼装：零件只有一种接法
title.en: Assembly: the parts fit only one way

ask.zh: 四个零件：CH_{3}–CH<、(CH_{3})_{2}CH–CH_{2}–、对位的 –C_{6}H_{4}–、–COOH。能拼出几种骨架？
ask.en: Four parts: CH_{3}–CH<, (CH_{3})_{2}CH–CH_{2}–, a para –C_{6}H_{4}–, and –COOH. How many skeletons can they make?

text.zh: 数一数每个零件还空着几根键。
text.en: Count the free bonds on each part.

rule.zh: CH_{2} 是双峰，所以它不能连 CH-3（否则会多裂一次）；H-3 是四重峰，同理。于是 CH-3 的两根空键只能给苯环和 COOH。
rule.en: The CH_{2} is a doublet, so it cannot be bonded to CH-3, which would split it further. H-3 is a quartet, so the same holds in reverse. The two free bonds of CH-3 can therefore only go to the ring and to COOH.

so.zh: 只剩一种：CH-3 同时连苯环和 COOH，异丁基的 CH_{2} 连在苯环的对位。
so.en: Only one arrangement is left: CH-3 carries both the ring and COOH, and the isobutyl CH_{2} sits on the ring para to it.

check.zh: 位移也对得上：2.44 是苄位 CH_{2} 的典型位置，3.69 符合同时连着芳环和羧基的 CH。下一步用 HMBC 直接验证 CH-3 连在环上。
check.en: The shifts agree: 2.44 is typical of a benzylic CH_{2}, and 3.69 fits a CH bearing both an aryl ring and a carboxyl group. HMBC next tests directly that CH-3 sits on the ring.

title.zh: HMBC：验证连接，并分清两组芳碳
title.en: HMBC: confirming the link and telling the ring carbons apart

text.en: H-3 (3.69) correlates with two aromatic carbons: 137.2 (no H) and 127.4 (a CH).

rule.zh: HMBC 显示 2–3 根键的 H–C。H-3 到它所连的环碳是两根键，到这个环碳的两个邻位 CH 是三根键。
rule.en: HMBC shows H–C pairs 2–3 bonds apart. From H-3 it is two bonds to the ring carbon it sits on and three bonds to the two CH carbons ortho to that.

so.en: CH-3 is indeed on the ring. 137.2 is C-5 and 127.4 is C-6. That leaves 140.9 as C-8, the carbon bearing the CH_{2}, and 129.5 as C-7.

check.zh: C-8 和 C-7 是用排除法定的。直接的证据应当是 H-9 与 140.9、129.5 的 HMBC 相关（图中带 * 的灰色虚线圈），来源正文没有逐个写出。
check.en: C-8 and C-7 are assigned by elimination. The direct evidence would be HMBC peaks from H-9 to 140.9 and 129.5, shown as grey dashed rings marked *. The source text does not spell them out.

text.zh: 核对：13 个 C、18 个 H、2 个 O 全部用上；5 个不饱和度 = 苯环 4 + C=O 1；7 组氢信号和 9 个碳信号全部归属。
text.en: Check: all 13 C, 18 H and 2 O are used; 5 degrees of unsaturation = 4 for the ring + 1 for C=O; all 7 proton signals and 9 carbon signals are assigned.

so.zh: 结构确定：2-[4-(2-甲基丙基)苯基]丙酸，也就是布洛芬。
so.en: The structure is settled: 2-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]propanoic acid, better known as ibuprofen.

check.zh: C-3 是手性碳，但普通 NMR 分不出两个对映体，所以这里不能说是 R 还是 S。
check.en: C-3 is a stereocentre, but ordinary NMR cannot tell the two enantiomers apart, so R or S cannot be stated here.
